title: GalactiWar - Empire Simulator
description:
A Galaxy That Lives Without YouGalactiWar is a galactic history simulator and space sandbox where the universe runs itself. Civilizations grow, empires expand, alliances form, wars erupt, and entire galactic powers crumble into history. None of it needs your direction. The galaxy has a life of its own, and you're here to witness it.

Watch history unfold over centuries as populations grow, cultures develop, religions spread, leaders come and go, and rival empires compete for survival. Empires rise to glory, fracture from within, or disappear beneath the fleets of their enemies. Unexpected events create unexpected consequences, and stories emerge naturally from the interactions between the simulation's systems.

You are a god with no direct control over the day-to-day operations of empires.

Observe the galaxy as it evolves on its own, follow the fortunes of individual civilizations, or use your godly powers to interfere with the course of history. Help a struggling empire survive, unleash destruction upon a galactic superpower, or simply sit back and see what happens next.

What Emerges in Your Galaxy?• Living Civilizations - Populations grow, cultures develop, and civilizations change over time.

• The Rise and Fall of Empires - Galactic powers expand their territory, wage wars, face rebellions, forge alliances, and eventually meet their fate.

• An Evolving Galactic Society - Diplomacy, trade, economies, buildings, and technological advancement shape how civilizations develop.

• War on a Galactic Scale - Fleets of frigates, destroyers, cruisers, carriers, and dreadnoughts clash in epic space battles.

• People of the Galaxy - Leaders, governors, and captains are part of the unfolding history of your galaxy.

• Unexpected Events - Random events, pirates, crises, and doomsday weapons can turn a stable era into a galactic catastrophe.

• A Galaxy of Statistics - Examine detailed statistics and follow the development, fortunes, and eventual decline of civilizations.

• Godlike Intervention - Use destructive or helpful god powers to influence events, change the course of history, or throw the galaxy into chaos.

Every galaxy has a history. Every empire has a story. And you never quite know what will happen next.

GalactiWar is for players who love watching complex simulations unfold, discovering unexpected stories, and playing god over a universe of their own.
description_short: You are a god watching over a living galaxy that runs itself. Empires will rise to glory and collapse into obscurity. Dramatic stories will emerge entirely on their own in an autonomous space sandbox. Intervene with your godly powers, or simply sit back and watch the universe evolve.
